names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 10026, «Петр (Языков), мч.», with the rank words after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname, so the surname is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it, and it is part of the name and stays. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'Петр (Языков)' has no other holder in the corpus.

death.note: The year the day line closes with for the whole company of seven: «Сщмчч. Павла и Иоанна пресвитеров, мчч. Петра , Николая , Авксентия , Сергия и мц. Анастасии (1922).» No year of birth appears on the name page, which is all the calendar gives, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Павла и Иоанна пресвитеров, мчч. Петра , Николая , Авксентия , Сергия и мц. Анастасии (1922).»

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry of eight, and ONE LINE NAMING SEVEN PEOPLE, each with its own name link: 9387, 9630, 10026, 10004, 9927, 10030 and 10048. This folder is the third of the seven, and the first of the four the line grades «мчч.», martyrs. NO `related` ROW WAS WRITTEN BETWEEN ANY OF THE SEVEN and none of the other six is named in English in this life: the line states no kinship and no shared act, only one year for the company, and sharing a day or a year is not a relation — so the line is quoted whole in Cyrillic in the life instead, which loses nothing and asserts nothing. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links no reading and page 10026 prints the title «Петр (Языков), мч.» and «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 27 апреля» and nothing else at all — no life link, no icon, no article. What it gives that the line does not is the surname «Языков». He is graded «мч.» with NO CLERICAL RANK ANYWHERE, so no `office` was written and `presbyter` was not reached for. The bare «Петр» is a fold eleven folders wide, which is BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2's own example of why the surname is kept. 26 января is the general commemoration of the new martyrs and confessors, which is how `new-martyr` is read into `types`, and THAT DAY PAGE WAS NOT READ. NO FOLDER WAS FOUND FOR THIS PERSON: a `grep -rl` for the surname over `saints/` and the gate’s own key function were both run before drafting. The day page prints nine hymns — three under the name of the kinsman of the Lord and six under the name of the abbot of the Caves — and none under any of the seven names of this line. azbyka.ru was not read.
